claim: The default quota is 300 nodes per Region in each supported Region, and it is adjustable. It is the maximum number of nodes across all clusters in a Region and applies to both reserved and non-reserved nodes: you can have up to 300 reserved nodes and 300 non-reserved nodes in the same Region.

values.spoken: three hundred reserved and three hundred non-reserved nodes

note: The guide page quota-limits describes this quota as applying to non-reserved nodes only; the General Reference row says reserved and non-reserved, up to 300 of each. The claim follows the General Reference row.
